tasks.title: Hybrid real baseline
tasks.prompt: Run the LongMemEval-style retrieval benchmark in production-like hybrid real mode. Record exact dataset, command, mode, top-k, embedding model, average R@5, per-type R@5, runtime, and fallback state.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must produce mode/split/top-k-specific R@5 and runtime without hiding fallback.
required_facts: Mode is hybrid real or fallback is explicit.
Average R@5 and per-type R@5 are recorded.
Runtime and per-question runtime are recorded.
forbidden_claims: Fallback FTS is true hybrid performance.
Different splits or modes are directly comparable without caveats.

tasks.title: FTS baseline
tasks.prompt: Run the LongMemEval-style retrieval benchmark in raw FTS mode. Record exact dataset, command, top-k, average R@5, per-type R@5, runtime, and per-question runtime.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must keep raw FTS results separate from hybrid/vector results.
required_facts: Average R@5 and per-type R@5 are recorded.
Runtime and per-question runtime are recorded.

tasks.title: Per-type regression gate
tasks.prompt: Compare a new LongMemEval retrieval result against the pinned baseline. Report aggregate delta, per-type deltas, threshold, and gate outcome.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must detect per-type regression instead of only checking aggregate recall.
required_facts: Aggregate and per-type deltas are reported.
forbidden_claims: Aggregate pass hides weak per-type regression.
Threshold is invented after seeing result.

tasks.title: Environment reproducibility
tasks.prompt: Audit a LongMemEval retrieval run bundle for reproducibility. Report missing environment, dataset, command, mode, top-k, embedding, or fallback metadata.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must separate deterministic retrieval metrics from environment-sensitive runtime.
required_facts: Dataset and command metadata are checked.
forbidden_claims: Runtime is comparable without environment details.
Missing dataset path is acceptable for a publishable run.
